copy.intro: Room for eight, with a third row and four-wheel drive. A practical pick when the whole family needs one vehicle for the weekend.
good_for: Family visits with the whole group
Winter weekends out of the city

faq.question: How many seats does the Palisade have?
faq.answer: Eight seats, including a third row, so a large group can travel together in one car.

faq.question: Does it have four-wheel drive?
faq.answer: Yes. It is four-wheel drive, which helps with grip on snowy and slushy roads.

faq.question: What driver aids does it have?
faq.answer: Adaptive cruise control, lane keeping assist, blind spot assist and automatic emergency braking.

faq.question: Can I have it delivered?
faq.answer: Yes. You can collect it from us or have it delivered to your address. The delivery fee is shown on the booking page.

copy.intro: A compact blue SUV with four-wheel drive and a simple, easy-to-drive setup. Handy for city errands and weekends out of town.

faq.question: Is the Jeep Patriot four-wheel drive?
faq.answer: Yes. This Patriot Sport is four-wheel drive, which helps on wet and snowy roads.

faq.question: Does it have Bluetooth and cruise control?
faq.answer: Yes. It has Bluetooth, cruise control and air conditioning.

faq.question: Can I rent it by the week or month?
faq.answer: Yes. Weekly and monthly rentals are available. Send a request and we confirm before you pay.
